title: Spicy Sichuan Tofu Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew that combines the bold flavors of Sichuan cuisine with the simplicity of tofu.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic, ginger, and Sichuan peppercorns. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the red pepper flakes and cook for 1 minute.
Add the bamboo shoots, snow peas, and tofu. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes.
Stir in the soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sugar. Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, covered, for 10-15 minutes or until the flavors have melded together.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped scallions and Sichuan peppercorns, if desired.
